note: Source-only gate: exact outer-side pedal signed area centroid, even N, arbitrary M, denominator and ellipse domain audited

evidence.exact_claim: Fix a noncircular ellipse and a fixed confocal elliptic caustic supporting a primitive even N-periodic Poncelet billiard family. Drop perpendiculars from each fixed M in the plane to the consecutive tangent side lines of the outer polygon. Prove the signed area centroid of the resulting ordered pedal polygon is independent of orbit phase wherever its signed area is nonzero, and audit the source all-M domain. The general parity claim is distinct from the special point M=O and N=4. Repeated traversal and star winding require explicit treatment; hyperbolic caustics are outside the surrounding two-ellipse source setting.
